claim: § The Morphing Quality Distinction: morphing a function's parameter (B 0.001 to 0.003) stays a real string at every point, a path through physics space; blending two curve shapes passes through states that are no physical model at all.

pieces.what: Play an additive tone while morphing two ways: sweep B inside the stiff-string family, then crossfade the same two endpoint curves point by point. Hear whether one stays a string and the other doesn't.
pieces.walks_up_from: one stiff string, f(n) = n·f0·√(1+B·n²), with B at zero

pieces.section: Design Implication: Function Library Over Freehand Curve
pieces.what: The function picker the page specifies: choose a family (B, Bessel zeros, log stretch, waveguide, free draw), move its one or two sliders, see the curve against the flat harmonic baseline and hear it.
Push B past any real material (0.01, 0.1) and hear that the hyper-stiff string stays navigable, against free-draw scatter that does not.
One LFO on B moves all N partials coherently; the same LFO on a table of N independent detunings does not.
pieces.walks_up_from: a single scalar driving N partials
